No—I can’t browse the live web in real time from here. I can still help by:

- Using my built-in knowledge (up to my last training cutoff)  
- Reading and analyzing text you paste in (articles, pages, error logs, etc.)  
- Looking at images/screenshots you upload  
- Helping you search more effectively (queries, what to click, how to verify sources)

If you tell me what you’re trying to find, I can guide you step-by-step or summarize/compare sources you provide.
